title: French authorities to restrict the activities of loafers in factories

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5778
Date 9 / 5 / 34

May 9, 1934. Morning translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers

French Authorities to restrict the Activities of
Loafers in Factories

Local loafers often demand money from
factory owners. The Chamber of Commerce has sent
letters to the Settlement and the Concession Authorities
requesting them to restrict the activities of the loafers.

The Chamber recently received a reply
from the French Municipal Council stating that the
French Municipal Police have already been instructed to
take action in accordance with the request.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处。
编号 D 5778
日期 34年5月9日

1934年5月9日。晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸

法方当局拟限制工厂内游民之活动

本地游民常向工厂主勒索钱财。总商会已致函租界及法租界当局，请求其限制游民之活动。

本会近日收到法国公董局复函，称法国巡捕房已奉命按照所请采取行动。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5778
Date 8 / 5 - 34

May 8, 1934
Morning translation

Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers:

LOAFERS DEMAND MONEY FROM BUILDING CONTRACTORS

Yesterday the Chinese Chamber of Commerce sent
the following letter to the Bureau of Public Safety on the
subject of loafers demanding money from building contractors:

"Some time ago, the Shanghai Building Contractors
Association requested that loafers be prohibited from
demanding money from building contractors.

"On April 25, we received an official letter
from you state that you has given instructions to your
subordinates to prevent loafers from demanding money from
building contractors;

"We are now in receipt of another letter from
the Contractors Association asking that an order to the
above effect be displayed outside every construction location.
This procedure was established by a former Commissioner
of the Shanghai-Woosung Constabulary, in the 9th Year
of the Republic of China.

"We are now transmitting to you a copy of the
order issued by the Commissioner with a request that a
similar order be issued."

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处。
编号 D 5778
日期 34年5月8日

1934年5月8日
晨间译件

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

游民向建筑承包商勒索钱财

昨日，上海总商会就游民向建筑承包商勒索钱财一事，向公安局发出如下信函：

“前此，上海建筑业同业公会曾请求禁止游民向建筑承包商勒索钱财。

“于4月25日，敝会收到贵局公函，称已指令下属防止游民向建筑承包商勒索钱财；

“现敝会又接建筑业同业公会来函，要求将上述禁令张贴于每一施工地点门外。此项办法系民国九年淞沪警察厅前任厅长所确立。

“现随函附上该厅长颁布之命令副本一份，并请贵局颁发类似命令。”

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. REGISTRY. File No. 5778 Non Dxxxx）
Date ____ April 3, 1934

Subject (in full) ......... Chinese Chamber of Commerce - requests prohibition
of extortion by loafers.

Made by ......... D. S. Mac Adie ......... Forwarded by ......... W Duncan DSS

On April 1, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce wrote
letters to the Bureau of Public Safety, the Shanghai
Municipal Council and the French Municipal Council,
requesting them to prohibit the customary extortion by
loafers when work is commenced on any building or construction.
The letter stated that police constables as a rule do
not interfere with such unlawful action and in some cases
even secretly side with the loafers.

R. W. Mac Adie
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 ____ 1934年4月3日

主题（全称） ____ 上海总商会 - 请求禁止游民敲诈勒索。

撰写人 ____ D. S. Mac Adie ____ 转呈人 ____ W Duncan DSS

4月1日，上海总商会致函公安局、上海工部局及法国公董局，请求禁止在任何建筑或工程开工时游民惯常进行的敲诈勒索行为。信中称，巡捕通常不干涉此类非法行为，且在某些情况下甚至暗中偏袒游民。

R. W. Mac Adie
D. S.

特别科主管警官。

C. & S.
No. D 5778
Date 2 / 4 / 34

April 2, 1934
Morning translation
Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-
Loafers Intimidate Factory Owners
The Chamber of Commerce yesterday sent the
following letter to the Bureau of Public Safety, the
S.M.C. and the French Municipal Council:-
"On March 31, this Chamber received a letter
from the Manufacturing Trade Association stating that
loafers in Chinese controlled territory and the
Settlements demand certain fees from the factories
when they commence operations. If these fees are not
paid, they intimidate the factory owners and steal goods
from the factories. The policemen not only refuse to stop
the activities of the loafers but also secretly protest
them. We hereby request you to take action against the
loafers".
（批：A.S. 778）

刑事与特别科。
编号 D 5778
日期 34年4月2日

1934年4月2日
晨间译件
《申报》及其他本地报纸：-
游民恐吓工厂主
总商会昨日向公安局、上海工部局及法国公董局发出如下信函：-
“3月31日，本会收到制造业同业公会来信，称在华界及租界，游民于工厂开工之际向其索取特定费用。若未支付这些费用，他们便恐吓工厂主并从工厂盗窃货物。警察不仅不停止游民的活动，还暗中保护他们。特此请求你们对游民采取行动”。
（批：A.S. 778）
